name: Sakutto Panda ~Mousou Danmatsuma~
original_name: さくっとパンダ ～妄想断末魔～
source:
Kotatsu works hard for revenge. After last incident her school gets closed, and she is directed to a free school. She still can't heal her wounds, but with the help of classmates and teacher's training she tries to live a happy life. However, appearance of a certain person and article published in the  magazine give a push to rapid development of events.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
小龙为了复仇而努力。上次事件后，她所在的学校被关闭，随后被安排进入一所免费学校。她的伤口仍未愈合，但在同学和老师的帮助与训练下，她努力过上幸福的生活。然而，某个人的出现以及杂志上刊登的一篇文章，推动事态迅速发展。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
